verdict.rationale: Hummingbird documents its own APIs for the core objects: an Alerts API, a Case API for creating and updating cases, case listing and fetching, a batch case import API, and a filing API for validation, filing and status monitoring. However, nothing claims UI parity, and many UI-documented actions have no API evidence, and no OpenAPI spec was found. Those UI-only actions include attachments, file renaming, approvers, comments, exports, workflow configuration and settings. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage of attachments, comments, approvals, exports, settings and workflow configuration, a published API reference or OpenAPI spec, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
